configurations.name: Static File Server (Python)
runtimeArgs: import os,http.server,socketserver; p=int(os.environ.get('PORT',3000)); handler=http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler; handler.extensions_map={'.html':'text/html','.js':'application/javascript','.css':'text/css','':'text/html'}; httpd=socketserver.TCPServer(('',p),handler); print(f'Serving on port {p}'); httpd.serve_forever()
